page_note: 本页为报告执行摘要第18页，顶部是编号为 Figure 6 的双面板柱状图（左为按性别的工作小时堆叠柱、右为女性时薪占男性比例），下方为解释与注释文字，页面下半是两栏正文。

heading.title: After including domestic labor, women earn only 32% of men's hourly income
heading.subtitle: Gender gap including domestic labor hours, 2020–2025

figures.source_line: Sources and series: Andreescu et al. (2025).

components.evidence: left panel bars split into a solid lower part and a dotted upper part, totals 53 and 43
left panel stacked bars of hours, right panel plain single bars of percentages
left axis 0–70 hours, right axis 0%–70%, separate axes per panel
'Domestic labor / Economic labor' for left panel, 'Excluding / Including domestic labor' for right
both legend rows sit under the plots, below the 'Women / Men' and 'Conventional / Real' ticks
'Hours worked per week' and "Women's hourly income (% of men's)" set above each panel
'Average labor time (hours per week) (15–to–64–year–old) (2020–2025)' set vertically along left axis
bare ticks 0–70 explained only by rotated title '(hours per week)'; right panel '(% male hourly income)'
'53' and '43' printed above the bar tops; '61%' and '32%' above the right-panel bars
dotted horizontal rules at each 10-unit tick across both panels, no vertical rules
'Interpretation.', 'Notes.' and 'Sources and series: Andreescu et al. (2025).' printed under the figure
left bars green for Women, red for Men, while series identity is carried by dotted vs solid fill

new_components.name: pattern_fill_series
new_components.evidence: legend swatches: dotted-hatch box for 'Domestic labor', empty white box for 'Economic labor'
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一根柱的两段靠点状填充与空白填充区分，而颜色只表示性别，读某一段的数值必须先按填充纹理判断它属于哪个系列。

new_components.name: segment_boundary_only_readable
new_components.evidence: only stack totals 53 and 43 are printed; the internal split must be read at the dotted boundary line
new_components.why_it_matters: 堆叠段的数值只能通过段边界与0–70刻度比对推得，误差直接受10单位刻度间距限制。

new_components.name: category_is_series
new_components.evidence: right panel: 'Conventional' bar is blue = 'Excluding domestic labor', 'Real' = 'Including domestic labor'
new_components.why_it_matters: 右面板每个类别只有一根柱且与图例一一对应，定位一个值时类别名与系列名冗余，表格行可能只保留其中一个。

spot_checks.mark: the Women bar's lower solid 'Economic labor' segment in the left panel
the Women bar's upper dotted 'Domestic labor' segment (53 minus the economic part)
the Men bar's lower solid 'Economic labor' segment in the left panel
the Men bar's upper dotted 'Domestic labor' segment (43 minus the economic part)
the 'Conventional' blue bar in the right panel, labelled 61%
the 'Real' orange bar in the right panel, labelled 32%

difficulty_notes: 六个目标值里只有 61% 和 32% 被印在图上，左面板四个堆叠段一个数字都没印：柱顶只标了 53 与 43。要得到 20、33、33、10 必须在 0,10,…,70 的刻度上量段边界，刻度间距10单位而 10 这个段 5% 容差只有 ±0.5 单位，约为一格的二十分之一；Men 柱的边界又与 30 到 40 之间的虚线网格错开，几乎无法在容差内读出。相比之下定位标签只需 3 个键（面板名+Women/Men+Domestic/Economic labor），面板标题以粗体形式存在，反而不是主要障碍。
